summary_en: This trial compares endoscopic surveillance with endoscopic eradication therapy in people with Barrett's esophagus and low-grade dysplasia, a condition that can be linked to esophageal adenocarcinoma. Eradication therapy uses radiofrequency ablation through an endoscope every 2 to 3 months until intestinal metaplasia is gone or up to 5 treatments are given, followed by surveillance endoscopy every 6 months for the first year and then yearly. The record does not state the main outcome measure, and the study phase is listed as NA.
summary_es: Este ensayo compara la vigilancia endoscópica con la terapia endoscópica de erradicación en personas con esófago de Barrett y displasia de bajo grado, una afección que puede estar relacionada con el adenocarcinoma de esófago. La terapia de erradicación usa ablación por radiofrecuencia a través de un endoscopio cada 2 a 3 meses, hasta que desaparezca la metaplasia intestinal o se completen hasta 5 tratamientos, seguida de endoscopias de vigilancia cada 6 meses durante el primer año y luego cada año. El registro no indica cuál es el resultado principal que se mide, y la fase del estudio aparece como NA.
who_for: Barrett's esophagus with low-grade dysplasia confirmed by a central pathology panel within the previous 12 months
Able to tolerate proton pump inhibitor or potassium-competitive acid blocker therapy, by self-report
Able to stop antiplatelet and anticoagulant medicines as guidelines advise around procedures
not_for: Prior endoscopic eradication therapy for Barrett's esophagus
History of high-grade dysplasia or esophageal adenocarcinoma, or prior esophagectomy
Active erosive esophagitis (Los Angeles Grade B or higher), until it resolves
Esophageal varices, known portal hypertension, or life expectancy under 2 years
